text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D24","page":1,"quote":"⌀8   H7 THRU`"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀8 H7 hole (D24) is a tight ISO fit on a part that receives zinc plating, but no allowance or instruction is given to account for the plating thickness inside the bore. The added plating will shrink the hole and can prevent the mating pin from assembling; the designer should add a pre-plate reaming size or a note to ream/mask after plating.","recommended_correction":"Specify an oversize before plating so the finished hole meets H7, or add a masking/reaming-after-plating note."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-\n1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 28-32 HRC.\n2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies hardness 28-32 HRC but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment applies (before machining, after roughing, or before surface treatment). Without a defined sequence the shop may harden the part too late, making precision features like the H7 hole unmachinable, or too early and lose hardness during later operations; the designer should add the process stage.","recommended_correction":"Add the stage to N1, e.g. 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 28-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING AND BEFORE FINAL MACHINING AND SURFACE TREATMENT.'"}]}
